description: This file defines an abstract class 'Entry' which serves as a base class for representing nodes in a documentation or directory tree. It manages properties like title, name, URI, parent directory, file info, and path, with methods to set and retrieve these properties, as well as to generate URLs and paths within the structure.

classes.name: Entry
classes.description: An abstract base class representing an entry (file or directory) in a tree structure, providing common properties and methods for hierarchical navigation, URL/path generation, and property management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes an Entry with the parent directory, URI, and optional file info; registers itself with the parent.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the entry, or null if not set.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the entry.

methods.name: getUri
methods.description: Returns the URI of the entry.

methods.name: setUri
methods.description: Sets the URI of the entry, updating parent's child list accordingly.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns the title of the entry, or null if not set.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Sets the title of the entry.

methods.name: getNameForSort
methods.description: Provides a fallback string for sorting, prioritizing name, then title, then URI.

methods.name: getParent
methods.description: Returns the parent Directory object, or null.

methods.name: getParents
methods.description: Returns an array of parent directories starting from the root.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Returns the file path associated with this entry, or null.

methods.name: getRelativePath
methods.description: Returns the relative path from the root directory.

methods.name: getUrl
methods.description: Constructs and returns the URL path to this entry.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Returns an array snapshot of the entry's properties for debugging or inspection.

methods.name: isHotPath
methods.description: Determines if this node is part of a 'hot path' in the structure.
